title: Brother and Sister, Garden Stone Statue - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A deckle-edged square snapshot featuring an older brother resting his arm affectionately around his younger sister. They are standing in front of a stone masonry bench or fountain basin topped with a classical sculpted figure, backed by a lush wall of dense ivy and foliage. The boy wears a light short-sleeve collared shirt and cuffed trousers, while the girl is dressed in a patterned A-line shift dress and white ankle socks, quintessential for late 1960s American youth fashion. The top margin is stamped 'SEP 68', documenting a late-summer family outing or vacation during a turbulent era of modern American history.
